# Pencil case

I keep a pencil in my bag. Some days it is the only tool I need.

> A tool you carry beats a tool you own.

The case also holds a thumbtack, a ruler, and some string. None of it matters much.

I once tried to carry a whole notebook, but it never left the drawer.

Writing is mostly deciding what to leave out. The rest takes care of itself, most days.

The last line stays where it is.
